## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/kian3/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Documents/lessen/Thesis")
library(tidyverse)

# Make paths to the files
files <- rep("", 30)
competitions <- c("Bundesliga", "Eredivisie", "LaLiga", "Ligue 1", "PL", "Serie A")
seasons <- c("2021", "2122", "2223", "2324", "2425")
index <- 0

for (i in competitions) {
  for (j in seasons){
    index <- index + 1
    files[index] <- paste0("Processed_full_stats/", i, "/", i, "_", j, ".csv")
    }
}

# Make paths to the JPL files
jpl_files <- rep("", 10)
jpl_index <- 0
rounds <- c("playoffs", "regular_season")
seasons <- c("2021", "2122", "2223", "2324", "2425")

for (i in rounds) {
  for (j in seasons){
    jpl_index <- jpl_index + 1
    jpl_files[jpl_index] <- paste0("Processed_full_stats/JPL/JPL_", j, "_", i, ".csv")
    }
}

# Combine all files in one object
files <- c(files, jpl_files)

# Add column round for La Liga files
La_liga_files <- files[11:15]
La_liga_df <- read_csv(La_liga_files, id = "comp_season")
La_liga_df <- La_liga_df |> 
  mutate(Round = "LaLiga") |> 
  relocate(Round)

files <- files[-c(11:15)]

# Add column round for one ligue 1 file
ligue1_file <- files[13]
ligue1_df <- read_csv(ligue1_file, id = "comp_season")
ligue1_df <- ligue1_df |> 
  mutate(Round = "Ligue 1") |> 
  relocate(Round)

files <- files[-13]

# Add column round for Pl files
PL_files <- files[15:19]
PL_df <- read_csv(PL_files, id = "comp_season")
PL_df <- PL_df |> 
  mutate(Round = "PL") |> 
  relocate(Round)

files <- files[-c(15:19)]

# Add column round for some serie A files
serieA_files <- files[c(15, 16, 18, 19)]
serieA_df <- read_csv(serieA_files, id = "comp_season")
serieA_df <- serieA_df |> 
  mutate(Round = "Serie A") |> 
  relocate(Round)

files <- files[-c(15, 16, 18, 19)]
full_df <- read_csv(files, id = "comp_season")
full_df <- rbind(full_df, serieA_df, ligue1_df, La_liga_df, PL_df)

# Extract number of passes and passing accuracy columns
full_df <- full_df %>%
  mutate(
    Home_Number_passes = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Passing_accuracy, "(?<=of )\\d+")), # (?<=of ) sees if "of" is before the number but drops of, \\d+ takes then all digits folowing the of.  
    Home_Passing_accuracy = str_extract(Home_Passing_accuracy, "\\d+%$"),
# $ makes sure to take the digits at the end of the string folowed by a %
    
    Away_Number_passes = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Passing_accuracy, "(?<=of )\\d+")),

    Away_Passing_accuracy = str_extract(Away_Passing_accuracy, "^\\d+%"), 
# ^ makes sure to take them at the start of the string
    Home_shots = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Shots_on_Target, "(?<=of )\\d+")), 
    Home_Shots_on_Target = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Shots_on_Target, "^\\d+")), 
    Away_shots = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Shots_on_Target, "(?<=of )\\d+")), 
    Away_Shots_on_Target = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Shots_on_Target, "\\d+(?= of)")),
    Home_Saves_accuracy = str_extract(Home_Saves, "\\d+%$"),
    Home_Saves = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Saves, "^\\d+")),
    Away_Saves_accuracy = str_extract(Away_Saves, "^\\d+%"),
    Away_Saves = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Saves, "\\d+(?= of)")),
  ) |> 
  relocate(Home_Number_passes, .before = Home_Passing_accuracy) |> 
  relocate(Away_Number_passes, .before = Away_Passing_accuracy) |>
  relocate(Home_shots, .before = Home_Shots_on_Target) |> 
  relocate(Away_shots, .before = Away_Shots_on_Target) |> 
  relocate(Home_Saves_accuracy, .before = Home_Saves) |> 
  relocate(Away_Saves_accuracy, .before = Away_Saves)

# Deleting empty columns 
df <- full_df |> 
  select(-c("Match.Report", "Notes"))
  
# Temporary saving for check
setwd("C:/Users/kian3/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Documents/lessen/Thesis")
write_csv(df, "Processed_full_stats/Full_df/full_df_1.csv")
```

```{r}
# Fix matches of Sparta rotterdam (Sparta.R.dam VS Sparta.R'dam) Nottingham forest (Nott.ham.Forest VS Nott'ham Forest) and St Pauli (double point in Home_team variable, 1 point in squad variable) because of wrong code
# This is done per season by filtering per season (competitions combined)
library(rvest)
library(xml2)
setwd("C:/Users/kian3/OneDrive - KU Leuven/Documents")
df <- read_csv("lessen/Thesis/Processed_full_stats/Full_df/full_df_1.csv")
problems <- df |> 
  filter(is.na(Home_possesion)) |> 
  select(comp_season:goal_scored)

links <- problems %>%
  pull(link)
scraped_full_data <- map_dfr(links[c(35:69)], team_stats_fbref_with_delay, .progress = TRUE)

scraped_full_data$xG <- as.double(scraped_full_data$xG)
scraped_full_data$PSxG <- as.double(scraped_full_data$PSxG)

df <- scraped_full_data

df_prepared <- df |>
  fill(Home_team, Away_team, Home_possesion, Away_possesion, Home_Passing_accuracy, Away_Passing_accuracy, Home_Shots_on_Target, Away_Shots_on_Target, Home_Saves, Away_Saves, Home_Corners, Away_Corners) |>
  mutate(Minute = parse_number(as.character(Minute))) |>
  filter(!is.na(xG)) 

df_prepared$Home_team <- gsub(".", " ", df_prepared$Home_team, fixed = TRUE)
df_prepared$Away_team <- gsub(".", " ", df_prepared$Away_team, fixed = TRUE)
df_prepared$Squad <- gsub("-", " ", df_prepared$Squad, fixed = TRUE)
df_prepared$Squad <- gsub(".", " ", df_prepared$Squad, fixed = TRUE)
df_prepared$Squad <- gsub("'", " ", df_prepared$Squad, fixed = TRUE)

main_stats <- df_prepared |> 
  group_by(Home_team, Away_team) |> 
  slice_head(n=1) |> 
  select(Home_team:Away_Corners)
  
shot_stats <- df_prepared |>
  group_by(Home_team, Away_team) |>
  summarise(
    # 0-15 minutes 
    Home_xG_15 = sum(xG[Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_PSxG_15 = sum(PSxG[Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Goal_15 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Saved_15 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Blocked_15 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_OffTarget_15 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Woodwork_15 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Away_xG_15 = sum(xG[Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_PSxG_15 = sum(PSxG[Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Goal_15 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Saved_15 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Blocked_15 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_OffTarget_15 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Woodwork_15 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute <= 15 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    # 16-30 minutes
    Home_xG_30 = sum(xG[Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_PSxG_30 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Goal_30 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Saved_30 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Blocked_30 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_OffTarget_30 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Woodwork_30 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    Away_xG_30 = sum(xG[Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_PSxG_30 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Goal_30 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Saved_30 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Blocked_30 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_OffTarget_30 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Woodwork_30 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 15 & Minute <= 30 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    # 31-45 minutes 
    Home_xG_45 = sum(xG[Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_PSxG_45 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),

    Home_Saved_45 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Blocked_45 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_OffTarget_45 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Woodwork_45 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    Away_xG_45 = sum(xG[Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_PSxG_45 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Goal_45 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Saved_45 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Blocked_45 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_OffTarget_45 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Woodwork_45 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 30 & Minute <= 45 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    # 46-60 minutes
    Home_xG_60 = sum(xG[Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_PSxG_60 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Goal_60 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Saved_60 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Blocked_60 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_OffTarget_60 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Woodwork_60 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Away_xG_60 = sum(xG[Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_PSxG_60 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Goal_60 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Saved_60 = sum(Outcome == "Saved" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Blocked_60 = sum(Outcome == "Blocked" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_OffTarget_60 = sum(Outcome == "Off Target" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    Away_Woodwork_60 = sum(Outcome == "Woodwork" & Minute > 45 & Minute <= 60 & Squad == Away_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    # 61-75 minutes
    Home_xG_75 = sum(xG[Minute > 60 & Minute <= 75 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_PSxG_75 = sum(PSxG[Minute > 60 & Minute <= 75 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),
    Home_Goal_75 = sum(Outcome == "Goal" & Minute > 60 & Minute <= 75 & Squad == Home_team, na.rm = TRUE),

    # 76-end
    Home_xG_90 = sum(xG[Minute > 75 & Squad == Home_team], na.rm = TRUE),

# Join by Home_team and Away_team
final_stats <- main_stats |> 
  left_join(shot_stats, by = c("Home_team", "Away_team"))

# Join with original df by Home/Away and Home_team/Away_team
# First replace - by a space like above
problems$Home <- gsub(".", " ", problems$Home, fixed = TRUE)
problems$Away <- gsub(".", " ", problems$Away, fixed = TRUE)
problems$Home <- gsub("-", " ", problems$Home, fixed = TRUE)
problems$Away <- gsub("-", " ", problems$Away, fixed = TRUE)
problems$Home <- gsub("'", " ", problems$Home, fixed = TRUE)
problems$Away <- gsub("'", " ", problems$Away, fixed = TRUE)

problems_final <- problems[c(35:69),] |> 
  left_join(final_stats, by = c("Home" = "Home_team", "Away" = "Away_team"))

problems_final_2021 <- problems_final %>%
  mutate(
    Home_Number_passes = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Passing_accuracy, "(?<=of )\\d+")), # (?<=of ) sees if "of" is before the number but drops of, \\d+ takes then all digits folowing the of.  

    Home_Passing_accuracy = str_extract(Home_Passing_accuracy, "\\d+%$"),
# $ makes sure to take the digits at the end of the string folowed by a %
    
    Away_Number_passes = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Passing_accuracy, "(?<=of )\\d+")),

    Away_Passing_accuracy = str_extract(Away_Passing_accuracy, "^\\d+%"), 
# ^ makes sure to take them at the start of the string
    Home_shots = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Shots_on_Target, "(?<=of )\\d+")), 
    Home_Shots_on_Target = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Shots_on_Target, "^\\d+")), 
    Away_shots = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Shots_on_Target, "(?<=of )\\d+")), 
    Away_Shots_on_Target = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Shots_on_Target, "\\d+(?= of)")),
    Home_Saves_accuracy = str_extract(Home_Saves, "\\d+%$"),
    Home_Saves = as.numeric(str_extract(Home_Saves, "^\\d+")),
    Away_Saves_accuracy = str_extract(Away_Saves, "^\\d+%"),
    Away_Saves = as.numeric(str_extract(Away_Saves, "\\d+(?= of)")),
  ) |> 
  relocate(Home_Number_passes, .before = Home_Passing_accuracy) |> 
  relocate(Away_Number_passes, .before = Away_Passing_accuracy) |>
  relocate(Home_shots, .before = Home_Shots_on_Target) |> 
  relocate(Away_shots, .before = Away_Shots_on_Target) |> 
  relocate(Home_Saves_accuracy, .before = Home_Saves) |> 
  relocate(Away_Saves_accuracy, .before = Away_Saves)

# Add to df without problems

df |>
```
